requirements.description: Full unsigned 2*WIDTH-bit product, in accepted order.
Valid exactly two edges after each accepted input; bubbles preserved.
Reset clears valid/data and cancels every in-flight product.

timing: Input accepted at rising edge n produces valid full-width unsigned a*b after edge n+2.
reset: Synchronous active-high reset overrides valid, cancels all in-flight products and clears output valid/data.
bubbles: No backpressure; accepts every valid non-reset edge. Output valid exactly tracks accepted inputs delayed two edges; invalid output data is unspecified.
assumptions: First edge resets; inputs stable before rising edge; sample settled post-edge outputs.
Operands are unsigned WIDTH bits; product is 2*WIDTH bits; drain or reset before experiment end.
